caption: Three cues for a better squat. #Fitness #SquatForm

beats.shot: side view of Rio standing with feet shoulder width apart
beats.does: stands tall with toes turned slightly out
beats.says: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.

beats.does: sits his hips back and down, knees moving in line with his toes
beats.says: Sit your hips back, knees follow your toes.

beats.does: keeps his heels flat on the floor at the bottom of the squat
beats.says: Keep your heels down the whole time.

beats.does: rises up with his chest up and back straight
beats.says: Chest up, drive up through your whole foot.

beats.does: finishes standing tall and nods to the camera
beats.says: Slow and controlled beats heavy and sloppy.
